name: Compresto

surfaces.surface_type: main-window (media grid + inspector form, single window) — marketing composite over a saturated wallpaper; window is the evidence
failures: #9 text contrast — Compress label cyan #5FFCFF on blue #0075F0 ~3.5:1, below the 4.5:1 HIG requires on a prominent tint (clears large-text 3:1)
#10 UI contrast — hairline row dividers and group-card edges read <3:1 over the warm translucency
native#2 glass-in-content — media grid + inspector sit on translucent wallpaper-tinted material instead of an opaque content surface
native#6 marginal — CTA accent possibly hard-coded rather than bound to controlAccentColor
#14 focus appearance not observable in a static cover (n/a, not counted as a fail)

tokens.value: translucent whole-window material, warm wallpaper-tinted (cool at top, amber at bottom)
tokens.notes: not opaque; content sits on glass — wallpaper-contaminated, intensity exaggerated by marketing backdrop

tokens.value: unified translucent ~33pt, centered bold title, 3 trailing borderless SF Symbols (pin/clipboard/gear)
full-width capsule ~265x42pt, fill #0075F0, label #5FFCFF cyan bold
native double-chevron pop-up button ~24-28pt, ~6pt radius, neutral fill
tokens.notes: title shows current value - correct pop-up grammar

tokens.value: system blue ~#0075F0, bound only to the CTA
two-column: left media grid ~55% (2-col masonry) / right inspector ~40%

patterns.key_values: right-hand SwiftUI Form: grouped rounded cards, label-left/control-right rows, hairline dividers, pop-up buttons + switches, full-width capsule primary pinned at panel bottom
left masonry media grid, 2-col variable-height rounded thumbnails (~12-16pt), glass pill badges (format|size) top-left + filename capsule bottom, play glyph + duration pill on video tiles
unified translucent titlebar, centered title, one trailing group of 3 borderless SF Symbols (pin/clipboard/gear), no toolbar primary (primary lives in content)

signature_moves: Wallpaper-tinted whole-window glass — media grid AND inspector float on one translucent, desktop-tinted sheet (identity move + native liability)
Candy-blue full-width Compress bar with a cyan (not white) label — the sole saturated element; strong action-singularity, low label contrast
Glass pill metadata (format/size badges, filenames) riding the thumbnails instead of a caption bar
defects: Glass-in-content — content grid + inspector on translucent wallpaper-tinted material; HIG keeps content opaque (mitigation: amplified by marketing wallpaper)
Contrast Dilution — Compress label cyan #5FFCFF on blue #0075F0 ~3.5:1, below the 4.5:1 required on a prominent tint
Faint UI contrast — hairline dividers / group-card edges likely <3:1 over the translucency
Flat label-vs-value hierarchy (minor) — pop-up row label and current value share weight/darkness
Possible hard-coded accent — CTA blue may not be bound to controlAccentColor

aesthetic.direction: Apple Liquid Glass crossed with Organic/soft — wallpaper-lit consumer utility, not a template default; commits to warmth and translucency as identity rather than defaulting to neutral gray chrome

psychology: Jakob's Law — conventional converter layout (sources left, settings right, big action bottom); users arrive already trained on it
Von Restorff / signal detection — one saturated blue CTA breaks a warm-neutral field so the single action is unmissable
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — the pretty translucent warmth raises perceived usability and buys first-contact forgiveness
Hick's Law (calibrated) — ~13 controls exposed at once; acceptable for an adjust-then-batch workspace, mildly heavy for casual consumers; progressive disclosure per media type would reduce it
Recognition over recall — pop-up buttons show current values inline rather than hiding state
notes: SINGLE marketing-composite input (cover only; gallery empty, no shots). Window is genuine design evidence; the flower-field backdrop is brand/marketing evidence and is NOT design evidence. Whole-window translucency is a real material choice but its intensity is exaggerated by the saturated wallpaper — treat glass-in-content as real-but-softened until a neutral-desktop or in-app shot arrives. No dark mode, no selection/hover/focus states, no Settings window seen. Scale ~2.26 px/pt (~@2x). Lineage native (SwiftUI) med-high; the inset-grouped rounded cards are SwiftUI's macOS Form grammar, not a Catalyst tell. Icon.png (black rounded-square with a white bowtie/butterfly 'compress-inward' mark) was present but this task is Workflow A (UI) only — not digested here; worth an icon pass later.
